evidence_snippets: To detect text in images, specify any text-based infoType, such as PERSON NAME and CREDIT CARD NUMBER in your inspection or redaction configuration.

For more information, see the following: Inspect an image for sensitive objects Object redaction Image safety classification Sensitive Data Protection can classify and redact images based on their thematic content.
Recognize objects and themes in images Sensitive Data Protection can analyze the pixels and features of images that aren't primarily text-based.
